epics.title: Baseline and hygiene
epics.summary: Reconcile policy, make hooks staged-aware, and run shadow checks without changing main protection.

epics.title: Classify changes and prove impact selection
epics.summary: Implement Ship/Show/Ask policy and compare scoped checks with full checks before enabling auto-merge.

epics.title: Protect main and enable reviewed auto-merge
epics.summary: Require an always-present gate, reject agent direct pushes, and keep Ask owner approval.

epics.title: Operate and measure
epics.summary: Track incidents and GitHub delivery metrics, then adjust only from measured outcomes.

tasks.title: Panel acceptance of ADR-035 (simulation done)
decisions: Human records real simulator output, sensitivity and rationale; no invented score.
Change at most 400 lines total.
tasks.current_state: ADR-035 is proposed and simulation is pending.
tasks.desired_state: The agent panel has reviewed the simulation and recorded ADR-035 acceptance or rejection with report links.
acceptance: From the simulator directory: python3 adr_sim.py --model trunk_based_flow --runs 5000 --seed 42 --outdir reports
tasks.agent_reason: Reversible decision: decided by the two-model agent panel under AGENTS.md "Decision rights (agent panel)"; the owner only gives final product acceptance.

tasks.title: Reconcile AGENTS PR verification policy
decisions: After ADR acceptance, define PR structural ledger check and full post-merge execution explicitly.
Preserve one PR per feature and never hand-promote ledger status.
Change at most 400 lines total.
tasks.current_state: AGENTS.md says the full verification pipeline runs on every PR, while CI does not invoke it.
tasks.desired_state: Written policy matches the approved two-lane workflow and keeps the ledger authoritative.
tasks.agent_reason: A bounded policy edit after the agent panel accepts the ADR.

tasks.title: Make Husky checks staged-aware
decisions: Use staged index blobs, including newly added files; never auto-stage.
Keep Husky 9 and server-side secret scanning.
Change at most 400 lines total.
tasks.current_state: A staged Rust/UI change triggers whole-project work; pre-push silently skips its guard without Node.
tasks.desired_state: Pre-commit checks only staged content quickly and pre-push fails clearly if its required runtime is missing.
tasks.agent_reason: Hook behavior needs careful index handling and failure-mode review.

tasks.title: Add shadow fast gate and full main verification
decisions: Keep existing CI visible during shadowing.
Require gitleaks in remote security job and keep an always-present summary check.
Change at most 400 lines total; split workflow edits if needed.
tasks.current_state: No required fast check exists; main failures are skipped by the feedback workflow; CI omits ledger verification.
tasks.desired_state: Shadow gate reports on every PR; full ledger verification and a linked incident run on every failed main SHA.
tasks.agent_reason: The workflow needs explicit skip, cancel and incident failure handling.

tasks.title: Implement path and actor classification
decisions: Unknown or sensitive paths default to Ask.
Agent Ship is limited to four files and 400 changed lines; label cannot downgrade computed class.
Change at most 400 lines total.
tasks.current_state: No enforced Ship/Show/Ask classification or actor rule exists.
tasks.desired_state: Each PR receives a fail-closed computed class and records feature ID or maintenance issue and check evidence.
tasks.agent_reason: Independent review of agent actor and path policy is valuable before ruleset activation.

tasks.title: Add conservative Rust impact selection
decisions: Include reverse dependents and fail closed on manifests, lockfile, CI and unknown paths.
A zero selected-test result fails.
Change at most 400 lines total.
tasks.current_state: CI only has a coarse Rust path flag and root-only Clippy/test jobs.
tasks.desired_state: Scoped checks include changed packages and reverse dependencies, with conservative full pre-merge fallback.
tasks.agent_reason: Workspace dependency edges and fail-closed selection need repo-specific implementation.

tasks.title: Panel review of two-week shadow evidence and labels
decisions: Require zero unclassified PRs and no missed full-suite failure before activation.
Record p50/p90 including queue time and cold-cache cohorts.
Change at most 400 lines total.
tasks.current_state: Three-minute gate and impact safety are targets without shadow evidence.
tasks.desired_state: The agent panel has a measured go/no-go record for branch protection; activating branch protection remains an owner-authorized outward step (T08).
tasks.agent_reason: Reversible decision: decided by the two-model agent panel under AGENTS.md "Decision rights (agent panel)"; the owner only gives final product acceptance.

tasks.title: Configure main ruleset and auto-merge
decisions: Require PR and always-present fast-gate; no agent bypass.
Ask requires owner approval after latest change.
Only owner holds documented emergency direct-push bypass.
tasks.current_state: Main rulesets only block deletion and force push.
tasks.desired_state: Direct agent pushes fail and Ship/Show auto-merge only after green fast gate; Ask waits for agent-panel approval.
tasks.agent_reason: Branch-protection and ruleset changes are reserved for the human owner.

tasks.title: Drill post-merge incident and revert PR
decisions: Create a linked issue on a failed main check; never silently auto-merge a revert.
Do not auto-revert migrations, releases or uncertain multi-commit failures.
Change at most 400 lines total.
tasks.current_state: Main failures are skipped by Jules feedback and no tracked response is guaranteed.
tasks.desired_state: A failed main run creates an incident and a safe single-commit failure can produce a reviewable revert PR.
tasks.agent_reason: Automated failure handling needs careful attribution and guardrails.

tasks.title: Report weekly GitHub flow metrics
decisions: Compute lead time, MTTR and change-failure rate from linked PR/run/issue data.
Keep merge-to-release lag separate from merge lead time.
Change at most 400 lines total.
tasks.current_state: Only a 30-run CI timing sample exists; DORA baselines are absent.
tasks.desired_state: Four weekly cohorts contain reproducible p50/p90 fast gate, lead time, MTTR and failure-rate results.
tasks.agent_reason: A bounded GitHub-data reporting script can be independently reviewed.

tasks.title: Panel review of rollout results (owner informed via the Product Acceptance Package)
decisions: Retain, narrow or roll back gate scope based on observed missed failures and recovery times.
Do not promote feature ledger status by hand.
Change at most 400 lines total.
tasks.current_state: The four-phase policy is proposed and may not meet latency or reliability targets.
tasks.desired_state: The agent panel records an evidence-backed continuation or rollback decision after four weekly cohorts; the owner receives it in the next Product Acceptance Package.
tasks.agent_reason: Reversible decision: decided by the two-model agent panel under AGENTS.md "Decision rights (agent panel)"; the owner only gives final product acceptance.
